arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# March 31, 1950 data
max_1950 = 275000  # millions
subject_1950 = 255013  # millions

# March 31, 1955 data
max_1955 = 281000  # millions (temporarily increased)
subject_1955 = 273571  # millions

# Calculate utilization rates
util_1950 = (subject_1950 / max_1950) * 100
util_1955 = (subject_1955 / max_1955) * 100

print(f"1950 utilization rate: {util_1950:.6f}%")
print(f"1955 utilization rate: {util_1955:.6f}%")

# Calculate arithmetic mean
mean_util = (util_1950 + util_1955) / 2
print(f"Mean utilization rate: {mean_util:.6f}%")

# Round to 2 decimal places (without percent sign)
result = round(mean_util, 2)
print(f"Final answer: {result}")
EOF
